text:
Ashley: Hey infra team — onboarding new tenant (acct 987654321234) in ap-southeast-4. Need GPU/eni quota increases so we can stand up a small Dedicated pool + host a few prod replicas.
Kevin: Which instance families and numbers are you asking for? any timeline? :calendar:
Ashley: Short ask + justification:
- p5 family (training/inference): current 40 -> request 180 (burst to 250 in month 1)
- g5 family (inference cost-efficient): current 100 -> request 320
- p4d (large seq workloads): current 8 -> request 28
- ENIs and EBS throughput: ENIs per AZ 250 -> 600, gp3 IOPS throughput increase to support parallel streams
Timeline: need initial bump within 72h for pilot, final numbers over 2 weeks. Customer is live in 30 days.
Samir: Can you paste the customer expected steady-state vCPU/GPU hours and estimated monthly spend? will help prioritization for support.
Ashley: Estimated steady-state: 60 p5 hours/day avg (inference heavy), 400 g5 hours/day across cluster, ~200 p4d hours/week during eval. Monthly spend estimate ~ $240k if we hit burst.
Claire: Two quick asks before I escalate the support case: 1) confirm account root email and full 12-digit account id, 2) any IAM SCPs or restrictions?
Ashley: Account root email: ops+tenant-x@redwood.com, account id: 987654321234, no SCPs blocking EC2 or ServiceQuotas.
Kevin: Can we avoid big increases by doing a staged approach? e.g. request p5 to 120 first and then scale via reservation/accelerators. Also check if we can use G5dn/G4s as fallback for non-critical replicas.
Ashley: Staged would be fine as long as support can speed up the second bump. They want guaranteed capacity for canary+two replicas.
infra-bot: Created support case SR-2026-98765. AWS ticket ID: 1234567890.
aws-support-bot: Hi team — received SR 1234567890. Please provide the Service Quotas Request payload and link to the account’s billing console. We'll route to EC2 capacity team for accelerated review.
Kevin: Pasting suggested CLI to submit quota increase (fill numbers):
```
aws service-quotas request-service-quota-increase \
  --service-code "ec2" \
  --quota-code "L-12345ABC" \
  --desired-value 180 \
  --region ap-southeast-4 \
  --profile redwood-onboarding
```
Replace quota-code with P5/G5/P4D specific quota codes and repeat for ENI/EBS quotas.
Samir: FYI, if this takes >72h we should pre-authorize a fallback: start critical traffic in us-east-1 and route via latency-aware DNS, or start using Hosted API for peak bursts to avoid customer outage. Both have cost implications but keep the customer live.
Claire: Also ask AWS to check underlying AZ capacity for p5 in ap-southeast-4. We've seen quota increases approved but capacity constraints block launches. Request capacity-check in the ticket.
Ashley: Noted. I added this to SR 1234567890: "Please validate AZ-level capacity for p5 and g5 families, and enable quota if capacity exists; if not, provide ETA to open capacity."
aws-support-bot: EC2 team replied: "We have received the request. If quota is approved, capacity is subject to AZ availability. If you require guaranteed capacity, please consider a Dedicated Host or Reserved Instances and contact your AWS account manager."
Kevin: Also, add a note to the ticket to prioritize ENI increases — network limit often blocks pod launches (we hit this last quarter).
Ashley: Done. I just updated SR. Screenshot of current console: https://console.aws.amazon.com/servicequotas/home?region=ap-southeast-4#/requests (shared).
Samir: For bookkeeping: tag resources from this tenant with cost-center=tenant-x and env=prod so we can track spend separately. Also prepare a short cost runbook for the account owners.
Claire: I'll follow up with infra-sre to prepare a fallback plan and a small autoscaling policy doc (min replicas, scale-step sizes) to keep latency SLOs.
infra-bot: Updated ticket SR-2026-98765 with notes: capacity_check_requested=true, eni_priority=true, staged_bump=true.
Ashley: Thanks all — will monitor SR and ping if we get approvals. If AWS asks for additional justification, I'll paste the workload profile and model sizes. :thumbsup:
Kevin: Thanks — ping here when SR status changes.
